owner_authorization.verbatim: 你没发现很多盈利的交易 其实止盈可以再高点吗。
owner_authorization.scope: reuse the already-frozen post-2026-05-04 BTCUSDT.P 1h snapshot for an exit-only diagnostic

question: Does the frozen 3R target truncate a repeatable right tail, and can a higher fixed target or a predeclared split runner improve realized post-cost results without changing entries, stops, or horizon?

predeclared_arms.rule: all size exits at 3R; frozen baseline
50% exits at 3R; the remaining 50% keeps the original stop and exits at 6R or the twelfth-bar close
50% exits at 3R; the remaining 50% has no profit target, keeps the original stop, and exits at the twelfth-bar close

split_execution.stop_before_first_scale: if the original stop and 3R are both inside the first-hit bar, record the full-position stop
split_execution.remaining_leg_collision: after 3R has been confirmed on a prior bar, if the remaining target and original stop share a later bar, record the stop first
split_execution.cost: subtract 0.2% once per original full notional; partial exits do not multiply total notional fee

metrics: target hit, stop, timeout and net-profitable counts
mean and median net bp, profit factor and equal-notional compounded return
equal-risk 1% compounded return and maximum drawdown
paired per-entry net-return delta versus fixed 3R
one-sided deterministic sign-flip p and paired bootstrap 95% CI for each delta
Holm correction across fixed 4R, 5R and 6R comparisons
count of baseline 3R winners that subsequently reach 4R, 5R or 6R before the unchanged stop within 12 bars

decision_rule.candidate_for_new_unseen_data: an arm must improve candidate mean net return versus fixed 3R, avoid worse equal-risk drawdown, keep the same sign before and after 2026-05-04 excluding partial September, and retain positive candidate-minus-control excess
decision_rule.statistical_note: all arms are post-hoc to holdout use 1; p-values quantify uncertainty but do not restore confirmatory status

forbidden_changes: K1/K2 morphology, gap, colour, path or state gates
training, promotion, deployment, ACTIVE/frozen/forward mutation or live orders
